---
title: "Area covariates: collinearity and the main-table selection"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  warning: false
---

Screens all static covariates of the full tables (`outputs/<region>/panel/*_full_allcovariates`),
separately for each region, and checks the subset kept in the main tables
(`MAIN` in `helpers/panel_table.R`). Counts and density are screened on a log scale,
as they would usually enter a model. VIF is the diagonal of the inverse
correlation matrix, so it needs no model. Render with `quarto render reports/<file>.qmd` from the repository folder.

```{r}
#| include: false
root = normalizePath(if (dir.exists("helpers")) "." else "..")
setwd(root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

```{r}
library(arrow); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
source("helpers/panel_table.R")   # MAIN

static = c("income_median", "gini", "pct_65plus", "hh_size", "pct_foreign", "pct_higher_edu",
	"unemployment", "pct_rented", "pct_hh5plus", "density", "built_share", "buildings_per_km2",
	"lu_residential", "lu_commercial", "lu_industrial", "lu_agricultural", "lu_green",
	"poi_industrial", "poi_retail", "poi_transport", "poi_essential", "poi_food", "poi_recreation",
	"poi_education", "poi_religious", "poi_buildings", "poi_health", "n_pharmacy")
logged = c("density", "buildings_per_km2", grep("^(poi_|n_)", static, value = TRUE))
per_bha = \(f) read_parquet(f) |>
	filter(date == min(date)) |>
	select(all_of(static)) |>
	mutate(across(all_of(logged), log1p))
cov = list(catalunya = per_bha("outputs/catalunya/panel/cat_abs_full_allcovariates.parquet"),
	madrid = per_bha("outputs/madrid/panel/mad_zbs_full_allcovariates.parquet"))
vif = \(x) diag(solve(cor(x)))
```

## Correlation, all static covariates

```{r}
#| fig-height: 9
corr = lapply(cov, \(x) cor(x, method = "spearman"))
lapply(corr, \(m) as.data.frame(as.table(m))) |>
	bind_rows(.id = "region") |>
	ggplot(aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) +
	geom_tile(colour = "white") +
	scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", limits = c(-1, 1), direction = 1, name = "rho") +
	facet_wrap(~ region, ncol = 1) +
	labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
	theme_minimal() +
	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 7), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```

Pairs with |rho| > 0.8:

```{r}
lapply(corr, \(m) as.data.frame(as.table(m))) |>
	bind_rows(.id = "region") |>
	filter(as.integer(Var1) < as.integer(Var2), abs(Freq) > 0.8) |>
	arrange(region, -abs(Freq)) |>
	knitr::kable(digits = 2, col.names = c("region", "covariate", "covariate", "rho"))
```

## VIF: all static covariates vs the main table

```{r}
main = intersect(MAIN, static)
bind_rows(
	lapply(cov, \(x) vif(x)) |> bind_rows(.id = "region") |> mutate(set = "all"),
	lapply(cov, \(x) vif(x[main])) |> bind_rows(.id = "region") |> mutate(set = "main")
) |>
	pivot_longer(-c(region, set), values_drop_na = TRUE) |>
	pivot_wider(names_from = c(region, set), values_from = value) |>
	mutate(in_main = name %in% main) |>
	arrange(-in_main) |>
	knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```
